content.short: ConsenSys ABI Decoder decodes events and data params from Ethereum transactions.
content.description: JavaScript library that decodes Solidity smart contracts' ABIs to expose events and data elements, helping developers interpret on-chain activity. It provides Vanilla JavaScript and Node.js implementations to decode transaction data and receipt log data. The project offers practical tooling for debugging, analytics, and integration into development workflows, and it maintains active community support with more than 500 developers contributing on GitHub. It targets networks such as Ethereum, Polygon, and Arbitrum.
